title: Tumanbay
subtitle: A fiction podcast on an epic scale set in the most powerful city on earth... Tumanbay.
description: A sprawling palace-intrigue drama built around power struggles, espionage, shifting loyalties, and the feeling that every victory is buying a larger disaster.

similarReasons.ars-paradoxica: Both trust listeners to keep up with larger systems and power struggles without flattening the human stakes.
similarReasons.the-waystation: A good next route if the listener wants worldbuilding depth and people trapped inside inherited structures.
similarReasons.midst: Useful when the appeal is less plot shape and more the feeling of a fully inhabited, pressure-rich world.

archiveTake: A strong recommendation when you want scale, political pressure, and a world that feels bigger than any single character.
